reviews.comment:
Es tremenda la atención, eterna la espera un día cualquiera sin que sea temporada, en un horario clave para la actividad. pero además no solo eso,sino el trato laboral. Había un solo empleado haciendo todo...hasta direccionando al camión de YPF
Una sola persona no puede manejar todo. Obvio la atención va a ser sumamente lenta.
Retrasa y atenta contra la libertad del usuario. Anda a otro lado me dijeron en la estación, claro hay 2 opciones en Miramar.

(Translated by Google)
The service is terrible, the wait is endless on any given day, even outside of peak season, during peak hours. But it's not just the service; the way they treat customers is appalling. There was only one employee doing everything... even directing the YPF truck. One person can't handle everything. Obviously, the service is going to be incredibly slow. It's a delay and infringes on the customer's freedom. "Go somewhere else," they told me at the station. Of course, there are two options in Miramar.
